region.name: Central Atlantic Region of State Garden Clubs, Inc.

ngcSupport: GGGC supports NGC's Plant America Theme through its community service projects and contributions to the Delaware Center for Horticulture and the Delaware Nature Society.
GGGC supports the President's "Go Green - Plant America" Project through its monthly community gardening projects.
GGGC established the CEW Training Award to provide financial assistance to members who would like to attend NGC Flower Show School classes or horticulture/design classes, at accredited institutions.
